label: shouldDismiss ignores the threshold, so a short drag closes the sheet (R-rn-sheet-dismiss)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/ProviderUsageSheet.dismiss.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R6: a short downward drag springs back and leaves the sheet open"

label: dragOffset takes the absolute value, so an upward pull moves and closes the sheet (R-rn-sheet-dismiss)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/ProviderUsageSheet.dismiss.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R6: an upward drag on the handle never closes the sheet"

label: the release handler drops its close call, so a pull-down never dismisses (R-rn-sheet-dismiss)
old:
onClose();
      // The sheet is going away; the next open must start at rest.
new: // The sheet is going away; the next open must start at rest.
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/ProviderUsageSheet.dismiss.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R6: dragging the sheet handle down past the threshold closes it once"

label: a cancelled gesture keeps its start point, so the next release dismisses a sheet already back at rest (R-rn-sheet-dismiss)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/ProviderUsageSheet.dismiss.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R6: a cancelled gesture neither closes the sheet nor leaves it displaced"

label: the drag strip shrinks under the 44pt touch floor, so the pull-down target is too small (R-rn-sheet-dismiss)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/ProviderUsageSheet.dismiss.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R6: the drag strip is at least 44 points tall and hidden from the reader"
